printLab.headline: Two products. Two dedicated pages.
printLab.intro: Memory Light turns nearly any photograph into a glowing, dimensional display for a home, gift, memorial, team, organization, or business. Mini Tap is a reusable tap card that sends a phone to the link you choose.

memoryLight.intro: Turn nearly any photograph into a dimensional 3D-printed display that comes alive when the light switches on.

miniTap.intro: A compact NFC piece that opens the link you choose. Reprogram it from your phone in under a minute whenever the next move changes.
